meta.name: Canonical AE Capability Contract Definitions
meta.technology_semantics: JSON is a repository/reference representation choice, not Canonical AE meaning

operation_defaults.implementation_proof_expectation: semantic mapping + deterministic resolution + applicable access/readiness evidence + authorized success/required denial

capabilities.name: Source Control
capabilities.purpose: Provide governed access to versioned source and engineering artifacts with exact revision/provenance semantics.

operations.purpose: Read governed source/artifacts needed for Planning, Execution, Validation, or context.
Resolve an exact revision identity for governed reference.
Create/update a versioned change through a governed machine path.
Compare revisions/changes for Planning, review, evidence, and Validation.
Submit a change into the organization's governed review path when applicable.

capabilities.name: CI/CD
capabilities.purpose: Run and inspect governed automated engineering workflows and recover their evidence.

operations.purpose: Discover applicable pipeline/workflow capability.
Start an applicable automated workflow when authorized.
Read execution status.
Read semantic workflow result.
Retrieve/reference pipeline evidence.
Promote/deploy when applicable lifecycle work requires it.

capabilities.name: Models
capabilities.purpose: Provide governed model invocation and enough metadata for material provenance/configuration traceability.

operations.purpose: Describe available model capability/configuration.
Invoke a bound model through a governed path.
Read model/provider/configuration provenance sufficient for material traceability.

capabilities.name: Runtime / Execution
capabilities.purpose: Start and observe bounded governed execution and preserve control over continuing execution.

operations.purpose: Start bounded execution.
Read execution status.
Read execution result/output metadata.
Cancel/terminate long-running or cancellable execution when explicit control is needed.

capabilities.name: Identity & Access
capabilities.purpose: Establish actor identity and scoped credential/entitlement context without requiring broad IAM administration or raw secret handling by agents.

operations.purpose: Establish authenticated actor/runtime identity.
Read identity claims/context permitted for governed decisions.
Establish scoped credential use directly or through mediation/injection without requiring raw secret possession by the agent.
Read relevant entitlement context where permitted and needed.

capabilities.name: Governed Tool Access
capabilities.purpose: Discover, describe, invoke, and inspect governed engineering tools without canonizing one tool protocol.

operations.purpose: Discover governed tools/operations.
Describe a governed tool operation sufficiently for safe invocation.
Invoke an authorized tool.
Read semantic result/provenance.
Cancel/terminate long-running tool invocation when required.

capabilities.name: Observability
capabilities.purpose: Emit and retrieve telemetry sufficient for AE operation, evidence, diagnostics, and learning.

operations.purpose: Emit/capture AE-relevant telemetry; may be automatic rather than reasoning-agent initiated.
Query telemetry relevant to governed engineering work.
Read telemetry results/evidence.

capabilities.name: Knowledge / Memory
capabilities.purpose: Provide governed durable knowledge access while preserving R2 authoritative ownership and immutable governed-artifact semantics.

operations.purpose: Read authoritative or referenced durable knowledge.
Query durable knowledge for context/reconstruction.
Write governed durable knowledge only within the authority/source-of-truth rules of the owning canonical state.
Create/use durable references without copying ownership.

capabilities.name: Work Management
capabilities.purpose: Administer AE work through governed agent-readable and agent-writable interfaces without routine Human mechanical mediation.

operations.purpose: Create durable provider work representing canonical AE work where required.
Locate work by applicable canonical/provider criteria.
Read current relevant provider work information.
Modify authorized work content/metadata.
Request/change provider workflow state when authorized.
Create/update/remove dependencies and required work relationships.
Add comments/annotations needed by AE.
Associate evidence, references, or related resources with the work object.
Associate relevant artifacts using any semantics-preserving provider mechanism; binary upload is not required.
Complete/close provider work when authorized.

capabilities.name: Validation
capabilities.purpose: Expose mechanisms for requesting/observing independent Validation without equating R6 with one validator product.

operations.purpose: Request/establish applicable independent Validation.
Read Validation activity status.
Read Validation result/judgment.
Read/reference Validation evidence.
